data.name: Chandrbhan
data.gender_notes: Chandrbhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandr means Moon and Bhan means God. This name is derived from the Hindu God Chandrama or the Moon God. The name Chandrbhan carries the meaning “Moon, God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Chandrbhan usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name represents the divine and spiritual energies of the Moon God, bringing peace, tranquility, and emotional stability.
data.etymology: Chandrbhan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrbhan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chandraban may be perceived as a symbol of the godly power and divinity associated with the moon in Hindu culture. This name may be often used in India and other parts of the world with a significant Hindu population. It reflects the importance of divine deities in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Chandraban holds spiritual significance as it embodies the power and energy of the Moon God. It is believed that invoking the name of the Moon God can bring calmness, peace, and stability to one's mind and life. In Hinduism, the moon is associated with the mind, emotions, and feelings, and this name can serve as a constant reminder to stay connected with one's inner self and to maintain balance in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chandrbhan: Moon (Chandr) and wise (Bhan). Symbolizes the peaceful, wise, and contemplative self that glows with the inner light of knowledge, like the moon reflects the sun's light.
